name: p06n_v1
frozen: 2026-09-28, user decision, before any operator evaluation of heldout_rich_h
purpose: Qualify the accepted P06 curvature operator (q1 material/remainder volume terms and the q3 characteristic face correction) with physical-normal Neumann states. The transported states n, Te, Ti are outside the reconstruction's exactness space, so the characteristic upwind correction is active. phi enters only through the q1 remainder (K.grad(phi)); omega is inert (no omega column in the principal matrix).
wall_data: Neumann states supply g_N = n.grad_x f from the field itself; Dirichlet states supply their analytic trace through the accepted lifted rows

field_sources.rich_a_minus1, rich_f_minus1: rich_a - 1 and rich_f - 1 (phi only enters through its gradient)
field_sources.zero_trace_generator: DRBX/scripts/p05n_field_derived_global/fields.py, (1 - u^2)(0.12 x cos z + 0.08 (x^2 - y^2) sin 2z): the physical phi = 0 wall
field_sources.coordinates: z = 2 pi eta / eta_period; every term is a smooth function of (u cos th, u sin th) times eta harmonics (axis-regular); n, Te, Ti stay within about 0.9-1.1

dirichlet_rich_purpose: All-Dirichlet case with the accepted lifted rows and an active upwind correction. It re-qualifies accepted P06's upwinded (U) operator with the corrected face census (periodic theta/eta slot n no longer double-counts the seam correction; accepted P06 run 58880303 counted it twice, invisible there because its corrections were ~1e-12 or smaller).
diagnostic: D: the same case with every Neumann state replaced by its Dirichlet counterpart (accepted lifted rows)
face_census: deduplicated: each physical face once (topology census); the accepted-P06 replay gate alone uses the accepted census with the periodic duplicate, to reproduce the saved accepted artifact
wall_exterior_contract: recovered Neumann trace (Dirichlet: prescribed trace) as the characteristic wall solve's boundary_trace; the physical-wall characteristic correction is zero by construction; not a physical wall-law qualification
gate: headline N-R global L2 order >= 1.8 on both intervals for every nonconstant case, equation (density, Te, Ti) and candidate, on the total term; material/remainder and N-D reported; acceptance decided by the user
disclosure: rich_a and rich_f were evaluated in the P05N outer-region test (not through P06). The P06N bounded construction used the provisional fields b1/e3/e12 only. heldout_rich_h has not been evaluated through any operator.
predeclared_expectation: Pointwise q1 terms: O equals R by code identity, so N-R measures reconstruction and closure. The characteristic correction is nonzero on interior faces for these states. Orders at N32-N64 may be pre-asymptotic (high theta harmonics under-resolved at N32), well above 2.
